name: smwmusic-ys-iii-wanderers-from-ys-melancholy-in-the-temple-s-ruins-illburns-ruins-remix
title: Ys III: Wanderers From Ys - Melancholy in the Temple's Ruins ~ Illburns Ruins (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Illburns Ruins from Ys III: Wanderers From Ys. Heavily referenced the Genesis version of this banger. Back at it with the Ys grind again after doing A Searing Struggle last year. Was playing Ys IV: The Dawn Of Ys and then thought I'd go back and do another Ys III theme (funny how that's what I got in my head)

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ Death sound is gonna sound weird (@0 replaces @9 to save on space).

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:

‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. B Minor (FAMICOM Pitch)
